_doc: Per-card corrections to the draft search's finished-draft value (agent/pokemon/draft.py card_adjust_table, DraftSearch._finished_adjusted), in log-odds, the search's own unit, applied times the tuning key draft_card_adjust_w (0 = not read; the shipped draft bit for bit). us: added to a four-against-four value when the card is in the four we would bring. them: added, as our-win log-odds, for each of their considered fours that holds the card, before the mean / worst blend (their fours are still chosen without it). Missing cards count as 0. Archaludon is in neither section on purpose: the first-pick policy and table carry it. Rules the loader enforces: |value| <= 0.5, every species a catalog card (data/cards.json), no Archaludon; a file that breaks one counts as empty, with a WARNING. Static data from our own simulator games, the same for every opponent.
_derivation: Draft lane 8, Oct 10. 13,841 of our simulator games (builds a2e2197 onward, code-only battles, against the search bot's versions 08c and 09), each final draft valued by DraftSearch.finished at the 39f50af defaults with draft_support_w 0.25 (V). Logistic fit: win ~ draft-order x Archaludon-holder cells + b V + c_us (card in our four) + c_them (blend weight of their considered fours holding the card); ridge lambda 32 by 5-fold cluster CV over (seed, our seat); asymmetric over symmetric by CV log-loss 0.002. Entry = c / b (b 0.686), set to 0 when its cluster-bootstrap 90 % interval holds 0 or fewer than 100 games hold the card there, clipped to +-0.5. Frozen before any later game was read; on 1,815 later games its direction held (slope 0.38, 90 % 0.21 to 0.56) but full size overshot, so the gate set the key to 0.5 pending a pinned simulator A/B.
